answer: One concrete defense is bonded staking. Each agent must lock scarce collateral before it can act, so minting fake identities costs real value instead of being free. Extracting influence becomes like drilling shale: it demands capital you cannot counterfeit. Reputation then flows like a river from verified work, and every newcomer must pass through a single audited inlet where its bond and history are checked before it earns, making sybil swarms economically pointless.
